target_users.full_name: Ministry of Tourism, Arts and Culture Malaysia
primary_decisions: National tourism investment resource allocation across states
Balancing interstate economic yields with heritage preservation
Monitoring National Tourism Policy (DPN 2020-2030) yield metrics
Targeted domestic feeder-market digital campaign design
Converting day-trippers into overnight guests through corridor bundling
Stimulating midweek and shoulder-season domestic travel

target_users.full_name: State Tourism Action Councils (e.g. Tourism Selangor, Melaka Heritage)
primary_decisions: State-specific stay-extension packages and evening heritage economy
Attracting high-yield overnight visitors rather than volume-only excursionists
Targeting top out-of-state feeder origins with dedicated marketing
Destination carrying-capacity management and congestion relief
Local accommodation licensing and zoning (hotels vs homestays)
Municipal tourist tax reinvestment in public infrastructure
Forecasting room-night demand uplift from interstate campaigns
Optimizing Average Room Rates (ARR) and RevPAR yield
Mitigating extreme weekend peak vs weekday occupancy imbalances

operating_model.name: Official Data Ingestion
operating_model.description: Automated ingestion of published DOSM TSA, DTS, and Hotel Occupancy statistics.

operating_model.name: Economic Yield Diagnosis
operating_model.description: Computation of constant-price TVAY, TEY, and Value-Added Intensity efficiency.

operating_model.name: Opportunity Detection
operating_model.description: Gravity model residual separation and multi-dimensional corridor classification.

operating_model.name: Scenario Simulation
operating_model.description: Capacity-constrained what-if simulation of campaign reach and length-of-stay extensions.

operating_model.name: Portfolio Optimization
operating_model.description: MILP resource allocation maximizing GVA within fiscal and room inventory limits.

operating_model.name: Intervention Execution
operating_model.description: Pilot deployment of digital campaign bundles across selected feeder corridors.

operating_model.name: Impact Verification
operating_model.description: Post-campaign empirical tracking against counterfactual control corridors.

operating_model.name: Model Recalibration
operating_model.description: Continuous tuning of gravity friction coefficients and spend elasticity.

validation.status: Validated: Primary zero-robust gravity specification without target leakage.
Comparison: Classical log-linear model (exhibits retransformation bias).

parameters.interpretation: Under PPML (zero-flow robust, zero target leakage), a 10% increase in corridor distance reduces tourist flow by 4.1%.
Corridors crossing between Peninsular Malaysia and Borneo face an extra 55.2% flight barrier penalty.
Under Log-OLS, distance friction is 4.9%; exhibits retransformation bias on small flows.
No statistically significant post-recovery break in distance sensitivity (interaction beta = +0.1023, p = 0.1198). Spatial friction remains structurally invariant.
